changes.before: The virus and the measures taken to protect public health have induced sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.
changes.after: Following sharp declines, economic activity and employment have picked up somewhat in recent months but remain well below their levels at the beginning of the year.

changes.before: Financial conditions have improved, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
changes.after: Overall financial conditions have improved in recent months, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
The path of the economy will depend significantly on the course of the virus.

parsed.rationale: The statement acknowledges a modest pickup in activity but also adds emphasis on virus-driven uncertainty, and the rate guidance and asset purchases are unchanged. The net policy signal is essentially unchanged.

spans.quote: The virus and the measures taken to protect public health have induced sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.
Financial conditions have improved, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
Following sharp declines, economic activity and employment have picked up somewhat in recent months but remain well below their levels at the beginning of the year.
Overall financial conditions have improved in recent months, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
The path of the economy will depend significantly on the course of the virus.
